verdict.rationale: Clerky documents that founders can issue and manage SAFEs and convertible notes through its software. Its form-based approach lets users customize key terms on provided forms rather than drafting from scratch, and a community user confirms access to a post-incorporation Fundraising package. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of e-signing for SAFE/note documents (signing on Clerky is only described for formations), confirmation of which standard templates are used (e.g., post-money SAFE), and hands-on corroboration of the SAFE/note workflow specifically.
